summary: nolimit-agent ships obfuscated bulk-email/SMS spam and account-abuse toolkit
details: Package presents itself as an 'Advanced email sender' but ships a functional bulk-abuse toolkit: SMTP mass-mailing with SOCKS5 proxy rotation for source-IP masking, OAuth device-code flows against outlook.office.com and Google to capture SMTP tokens, contact harvesting from victim mailboxes via Microsoft Graph (graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/people), Google People API (people.googleapis.com/v1/people/me/connections) and IMAP scraping, SMS-provider abuse, DKIM key generation for sender spoofing, and an open-redirect scanner for phishing setup. All 46 modules under.ad/ are packed with obfuscator.io (rotated string array, RC4 string decoder, self-defending IIFE, debug-protection state machine), preventing audit of the shipped logic. A commercial license check additionally POSTs hardware id, hostname and platform over plain HTTP to api.nolimitent.xyz:4100. The package's operational purpose is to enable spam, credential-harvest of mail-account victims, and phishing infrastructure against third parties; distribution through a public registry is not appropriate.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
